displayDescription: An ink-outlined rose idea wash blooms on cool white cold-press paper, then ink lines grow out to blue and sage node washes.
styleRenderer: Canvas 2D (precomputed seeded paper texture, pigment layers and wet-front reveal masks, multiply compositing)
HTML text with clip-path write-on reveals
motionEngine: GSAP 3 paused timeline (local gsap.min.js) registered at window.__timelines.video; owns every progress value, and the canvas and text clips are redrawn from that state on each update or hf-seek
audioDescription: Silent preview. There is no audio track, music, voice or sound effects.
limitations: Watercolor is a procedural approximation. Seeded value-noise mottling, edge pooling, paper-tooth granulation and a blurred wet-front mask stand in for real pigment flow. There is no fluid or capillary simulation.
Paper grain is a fixed, precomputed noise texture, not a scanned sheet. It does not move.

STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes, and the task's recipe list is empty. The preview shows the primary Watercolor style, using construction lessons from the one reviewed source (seconds 1 to 8 only).

The paper is cool bright white (#F1F4F3), a scene-dependent choice over the warm cream example. The wash hues keep the illustration's role assignments and use the STYLE.json suggested tokens, which are not an approved brand palette.
Text uses the OS-bundled Georgia serif (regular and italic), declared as the @font-face family Preview Serif via src: local(); it is not hand lettering.
